Overview:

Anakin Forge: Build AI Agents That Read, Reason, and Act

Anakin Forge is back, and this is our biggest one yet.

For one week, builders from around the world will come together online to create AI agents: real, working, autonomous systems that can read the web, reason through problems, and take useful action without a human clicking every button.

This is an AI hackathon for people who want to build with agentic AI, not just talk about it.

What You'll Build:

Your challenge: build an AI agent that goes beyond a chatbot. Think agents that can:

  • Browse and read live web content
  • Reason through multi-step tasks
  • Take real actions, like booking, filling forms, comparing options, or running a workflow end to end

Any stack, any approach. As long as the AI agent you ship actually does something useful.

The Details:

  • Format: Online, open worldwide
  • Duration: 1 week
  • Prizes: $1,000+ up for grabs
  • Cost: Free to join

Who Should Join:

Developers, AI engineers, indie hackers, students, and anyone curious about building with AI agents. Solo or in teams. All skill levels welcome.

This Is Just the Start:

Anakin Forge is the first of many drops. Beyond this hackathon, we've got prizes, raffles, bounties, and more ways to build, launch, and earn with Anakin AI coming soon.

Where It All Happens:

Registration, team formation, updates, and support all live in our Discord. That's the one place you need to be to not miss anything.\

Learn more here:

    • website: https://anakin.io/hackathon/anakin-forge

Join our Discord to stay updated:

    • Discord: https://discord.gg/CGV4Z49aVU
